notes: Manual tracing from unchanged Chamber_02.jpeg in top-left pixel coordinates. Paving continues behind tall silhouettes; cover footprint is the ground contact, never the full canopy.

Flower/soil island around the central three cypresses is solid; individual trees retain separate tight occlusion silhouettes. The western small island cypress is a separate object missed by the original catalog.
InnerGoldenCypress contacts the soil at y=653, roughly 45 pixels above the original helper footprint. GardenBrokenColumn also ends around y=510, above the original helper bottom.

The southern flowerbank and exposed cliff below the golden paving are outside the floor. Foreground parapet posts have footprints outside the reachable paving but silhouettes can occlude paving above.
Lower return threshold moved from (590,824), over a foreground pier/flower-bank edge, to clear visible paving (590,782). Original entrance (729,780) and return spawn (1120,354) retained.
Northern paved path extends along the east side of the EastGardenCypress toward the golden gate; the original boundary incorrectly cut across this clear route.

Rear peripheral trees are rooted beyond the northern floor edge and are excluded from collision cover. West and north arcade piers touching paving are included. SouthernForegroundCypress is rooted beyond the southern cliff, so its collision footprint is outside the floor while its canopy occludes reachable southern paving.
Close inspection of the northern gate identifies an additional inner left column at (1245,273). Exit moved from (1250,281) near that base to (1280,295) on the clear luminous threshold.

Foot clearance QA uses .45 world units with horizontal scale 72/1536 and vertical ground scale (48/1024)/sin(36 degrees), matching ImageToGround. Connected route QA additionally uses conservative .50 world-unit raster erosion.
